settings.score: negative log-likelihood in standardised feature space

training_timing_scope: Training loop including batch transfers and loss logging; excludes model setup, validation and file saving.
threshold_method: 95th percentile of normal validation negative log-likelihood; alert when score is strictly greater.
limitations: Foundational RealNVP implementation, not a latest SOTA model.
Continuous density is fitted to mixed discrete and continuous features.
Circular time features have a deterministic relationship.
Low density does not always imply a meaningful anomaly.
Results apply only to this synthetic dataset.
